execution: Independent runner executed in tp-watch; results copied from /home/opc/trading/pipeline/runs into this directory. Container lacks git; commit was verified on Oracle host.

us_universe.eligibility: vendor.instrumentType EQUITY; at least 200 valid close/adjclose bars before 2022-01-03; valid data through 2026-10-30

us_adjustment: Yahoo adjclose/raw close factor applied to OHLC; close uses adjclose.
us_fill: Coin_Trade rs_us_engine semantics: close(t) signal fills close(t+1); per-side fees 0.36% KIS and 0.08% CHEAP; US S1 uses 0/7/14 phase average daily return.
kr_scope: 10 selected KRX equities + KODEX 200 benchmark; not full KRX. Yahoo Finance chart v8 adjusted data.
kr_fill: Coin_Trade semantics close signal to next tradable open; commission 0.015%/side, small/large slippage 0.10%/0.05%, sell tax 0.18%; S1 source-native single phase.
strategy_configs: S4 EMA9/21 + SMA200, slots6, TP8%, SL4%
S5 Mach7 EMA10/50/200 defaults, top5, SL8%
S5 pullback SMA10 + turnover-volume filter, top5, SL3%, TP6%
limitations: Universe is bounded to cached Oracle equities; US listing coverage is incomplete and survivorship-biased.
KR coverage is selected 10 ticker sample, not full KRX.
US next-close and KR next-open fills differ.
Historical results are research only and not live execution proof.
